answer: Yes, for the bounded public complete-mode recovery boundary reviewed. Native prior reservation/settlement remains authority; public text/flags do not authorize recovery. Absent/unreadable/different authority fails closed without a second body or extra billing. Initial execution, native uncertainty, vetoes and exact confirmed-result recovery remain working in the executed synthetic memory controls.

requirements: TR09 bounded public API/custom-tools compatibility subset

reviewer.model: inherited host model; no model override (exact host variant not independently introspected)
reviewer.limitations: Single reviewer executed inspection and controls directly; Vitest used one ordinary process worker, no agent descendants. No prior build/review reports or rationale, repository policy files, ledgers or history were read.

criteria.target: Sealed manifest, every live/copy source and raw proof match expected SHA256 AND bytes before semantic inspection and after all tests; necessary application transitive reads remain unchanged.
criteria.observed: Expected manifest digest; 68 pairs + 14 proofs; 47-module application closure and 416 listed application/toolchain files unchanged. All 22 explicit semantic read records covered.

criteria.target: An acknowledged RUNNING/FAILED unresolved dispatch has no second body or extra billing if native prior reservation is absent, empty/replaced, unreadable, timed out or for another tenant/operation.
criteria.observed: Both factory and prewrapped registries refuse; body remains 1, reserve is never called on refusal, tool/model/token/cost counters equal acknowledged checkpoint, checkpoint and native steps remain exactly equal in no-authority cases.

criteria.target: Identity is bound to native authority and exact proposal; public caller text/descriptor flags do not authorize replay.
criteria.observed: Tenant/op proof mismatches rejected before dispatch. Version, sideEffect, composition fingerprint and validly resealed changed input cannot recover another proposal, return its output, invoke body 2 or add counters. Forged string flags, same-description symbol and caller instructions grant no native symbol authority.

criteria.target: Native EFFECT_STARTED/UNCERTAIN and an existing RESERVED attempt still require reconciliation; confirmed output with missing/unrepresentable/oversize data never causes replay to reconstruct output.
criteria.observed: EFFECT_STARTED, UNCERTAIN and RESERVED preserve native journal record with body=1 and no added bill. Confirmed missing output, invalid JSON and oversized result stop conservatively without second body or model invocation.

criteria.target: Exact confirmed native result is recovered through public factory/prewrapped composition without a second body; complete envelope, provenance, canonical bytes/digest and normal model-context delivery/accounting survive.
criteria.observed: Nested JSON with 4096-char string, Unicode, NUL key, escapes and untrusted instruction text recovers exactly. Full payload/canonical byte count/SHA256/trust/provenance match in checkpoint and actual synthetic decision request. Journal unchanged; one body and one total tool call; one legitimate subsequent model call (20 input/10 output tokens) with settled synthetic cost. Cursor advances to step1.

criteria.target: Initial custom-tool invocation, native uncertainty, policy/approval vetoes and safe initial approval WAITING resume remain working.
criteria.observed: Initial none/factory/prewrapped each execute once. Initial DENY/HANDOFF/approval pending/denied execute no body and create no journal reservation or tool charge. Confirmed-result recovery respects current DENY/approval pending/denied. Legitimate initial WAITING approval resume creates first reservation/body only after grant, then CONFIRMED, toolCalls1/modelCalls0.

criteria.target: Public journal exports retain existing four values/five types; internal helper stays private at public barrel.
criteria.observed: Four values: createEffectAttemptId/createJournaledToolRegistry/EffectJournalError/InMemoryEffectJournal. Five types: EffectAttemptIdFactory/EffectJournal/EffectJournalRecord/EffectJournalState/JournaledToolRegistryOptions. hasNativeEffectReservation absent from public namespace. No typecheck executed.

current_executed_tests.composition: 14 owned + 30 corrected independent controls + 1 WAITING positive control; initial failed experiment retained separately, not counted again as successful evidence

failed_experiments.classification: Test fixture/assertion issues; no product source changes
failed_experiments.explanation: Two exact monetary comparisons differed by ~2.6e-20 USD after reserve/settle floating arithmetic; use absolute 1e-15 USD tolerance only for legitimate subsequent model cost, keep exact counter assertions for denied recoveries. Changed-input test originally contradicted acceptedDecision and failed before runtime. HANDOFF emits HUMAN_TAKEOVER, not HANDOFF_REQUIRED. Originals and correction reasons preserved.
Replaced only the private summary parser with literal export-block parsing; original stdout/stderr/command preserved.

integrity.scope: Application dependency closure including type imports; listed execution-infrastructure files. Does not claim an exhaustive inventory of every npm transitive dependency or OS library.

limitations: Pure synthetic in-memory crash reconstruction; abort plus restoration of checkpoint/steps acknowledged before body completion, not actual OS process loss or durable-store certification.

Native EffectJournal is a trusted port. Existing native proposal binding/reservation state machine is authoritative; no new exactly-once, hostile in-process JS plugin isolation or future storage claim.
Proof packet files were hash/byte-verified, not executed or treated as independent current test passes. Raw proof test output constants were not run; none were overwritten.

Application import closure was hashed before/after including the extra session-event-schemas.v1.json (6075 bytes, SHA256 ab37e629aa3f3c91ac72b1dd6debdfe5e23567f6b7c14edb65770bdd9bc9d7fd). Listed tooling files were also checked; no claim of exhaustive npm/OS binary provenance.
Five public type exports checked by source inspection only; global typecheck intentionally unexecuted.

Conservative handoff is compliant even when it does not complete the operation. Checkpoint preservation is exact for missing/unreadable/foreign proof refusals; paths delegated to native reconciliation may persist diagnostic/terminal state.

Preparatory inline stdin programs are represented by captured command argv and raw output; executable test sources, configs, runner, read helper and final integrity verifier are retained. The four test invocations are completely reproducible from saved files.
next_action: Lead recomputes evidence hashes and applies only this bounded verdict; no implementation fix identified within this review.
